name: Pithampur Poly Products Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, Pithampur Poly Products Ltd is engaged in Manufacturing, Trading and Job-work of FIBC and PP woven bags and fabrics.
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1]
Fibc Baffle Bags, Flexible Jumbo Bags, Pp Woven Fabric Sacks, Container Bags, Two Loop Bags, Polyester Belts, Packaging Bags with sift proof sims, Polywoven Rolls, Single loop bags.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -12.6% over past five years.
Company has high debtors of 2,075 days.
